plan: This is a second-price auction format where the winner pays the second-highest bid, not their own bid. In this format, bidding your true value is the dominant strategy - it maximizes expected profit regardless of others' strategies. If I bid below my value, I risk losing auctions I should win. If I bid above my value, I risk winning and overpaying. Therefore, I will bid exactly my true value of $34.

In this second-price auction format, bidding my true value is the dominant strategy. Since I pay the second-highest bid (not my own bid) if I win, there's no incentive to bid above or below my true value of $28. Bidding higher risks winning at a price exceeding my value, while bidding lower risks losing profitable opportunities. Therefore, the optimal strategy is to bid exactly my value.
